acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of a full kitchen renovation in the East Bay area can vary significantly based on factors like the size of your kitchen, the quality of materials chosen, and the complexity of the design. Costs can range from a mid-range renovation to a high-end custom build. It's best to discuss your specific vision and budget with a contractor to receive an accurate estimate for your project.
